description: Generate a booking URL for selected car rental option. Creates a reservation link that can be used to complete the car rental booking process. Use after car_search, once the user has chosen a car. Returns a link where the user completes booking and payment on the site; nothing is booked or charged by this tool.

request_id.description: Top-level request_id from car_search or selected reservation allocation.arguments.request_id (starts with 'cr'). Do not use reservation.requestId.

reservation_id.description: Selected car reservation referenceId or allocation.arguments.reservation_id from search results (starts with 'ref').

trip_type.description: Type of travel: 'domestic' for within country or 'international' for cross-border from previous car search

name: car_allocate
title: Get car rental booking link
